archetype: Modern Light Luxury (Archetype 5 adapted for Light)

typography.strategy: Oversized, high-contrast serif headlines to establish luxury, paired with highly readable geometric sans-serif for body copy and booking details.

scales.overline: text-sm md:text-base uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#C5A059]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Create 'breathing room' around images and text to convey luxury. Use asymmetrical layouts for the gallery to avoid a 'stock template' feel.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Use Bento grid variants for services, mixing spans (e.g., col-span-2 and col-span-1) to create visual tension and hierarchy.

buttons.primary: bg-[#111827] text-white hover:bg-[#C5A059] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#C5A059] text-[#111827] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.ghost: text-[#111827] hover:text-[#C5A059] transition-colors duration-300 font-medium underline-offset-4 hover:underline

cards.service_card: bg-white p-8 md:p-12 border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300 rounded-none group
cards.testimonial_card: bg-[#FAFAFA] p-8 md:p-10 border border-[#C5A059]/20 rounded-none

navigation.style: Sticky top, crystal glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Bottom border 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05).
navigation.links: text-sm uppercase tracking-widest font-medium text-gray-800 hover:text-[#C5A059]

form_elements.input: border-b border-gray-300 bg-transparent rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:border-[#C5A059] focus:ring-0 text-lg transition-colors
form_elements.label: text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium tracking-wide uppercase

motion.hover_effects: Slight upward translation (-translate-y-1) for service cards, image scale-up on hover inside hidden overflow containers.

hero.subheadline: Over 11 years of master barbering experience. Precision cuts, straight razor shaves, and tailored grooming for the modern gentleman.

service_facial.description: A man getting a facial mask treatment.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use custom Tailwind classes combined with pure HTML for the Marketing sections (Hero, About, Gallery) to achieve the overlapping asymmetrical look described in layout philosophy.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Integrate Shadcn UI strictly for the Booking Flow (Form, Inputs, Select for services, Datepicker) and interactive elements like Dialog/Modal if the booking is contained in a modal.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Enforce the light luxury theme: use #FAFAFA and #FFFFFF heavily, text must be high contrast #111827. Gold (#C5A059) is for accents, overlines, and hover states, NOT large background areas.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Make sure all interactive and key informational elements have the 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-now-cta', data-testid='service-select').
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not center everything. Use left-aligned robust headings for 'About' and 'Services' to create editorial tension.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: In the booking form, use a multi-step stepper or cleanly separated stacked layout. Include Service, Date/Time, Personal Info, and a visually distinct Confirmation screen.
